jobs.occupation: Forklift Driver | Mechelen | NL or ENG
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a varied and challenging job in the logistics sector? GXO Logistics in Mechelen is looking for motivated Forklift Drivers to strengthen our team! 

As an all-round operative, you will be involved in various steps of the logistics process. 

Your tasks may include: 

 
• Checking, packing, labeling, and preparing products for shipment 
 

 
• Performing customized tasks according to customer specifications (customization) 
 

 
• Scanning and registering goods in the WMS system 
 

 
• Administrative processing in Excel and Word 
 

 
• Moving goods using EPT, stacker, or forklift 
 

 
• Reporting deviations and results to the team leader 
 

 
• Assisting with inventories and stock checks 
 

 
• Ensuring a clean and safe workplace 

What are we looking for in you? 

 
• You understand and speak Dutch or English fluently 
 

 
• You have experience operating EPT, stacker, and forklift 
 

 
• You have a valid certification for forklift. 
 
• You are familiar with WMS systems, scanners, Excel, and Word 
 

 
• You work accurately, are organized, and have an eye for detail 
 

 
• You are a team player but can also work independently 
 

 
• You have at least 1 year of experience in a logistics or production environment 
 
•  
You are physically able to lift heavier objects

 

 
• You are willing to work in a 2-shift system: 

Early shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM Late shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM 

OR in a night shift system:

10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

It is possible that you will be asked to work on weekends as well, so some availability and flexibility are required.

Responsibilities:   

 
•  
You support the development, optimization and management of technical products and solutions.
 
 
•  
You apply standards, guidelines and certification requirements, and support approval processes.
 
 
•  
You work closely with customers and translate their needs into technical solutions.
 
 
•  
You create and modify technical designs in CAD and manage the associated product data.
 
 
•  
You collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Production and Quality to address technical questions and challenges.
 

Required qualifications:   

 
•  
Master's degree in Electromechanics, supplemented with initial work experience.
 
 
•  
Practical knowledge of 3D CAD and MS Office.
 
 
•  
Strong motivation and willingness to deepen your knowledge of standards, regulations and certifications.
 
 
•  
Willingness to travel within Europe and the US.
 
 
•  
Analytical mindset and ability to critically assess technical data.
 
 
•  
Strong interpersonal skills and a good command of English.

• Diagnosing issues using STAR and MANCATS diagnostic systems
• Performing maintenance tasks on trucks
• Dismantling and/or removing certain parts
• Customizing for specific assignments
• Taking care of customer vehicles and ensuring customer satisfaction

• A higher education in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience
• Experience with diagnostic tools.
• Good English knowledge.
• Knowledge of general mechanics (or automotive mechanics), metalwork (welding), and basic electrical knowledge
• Team player but can also work independently
• Works accurately, are solution-oriented, and flexible to customer needs

You will be the analytical engine behind our clients' most challenging impurity investigations. You will design and execute highly sensitive mass spectrometry methods to ensure the safety and compliance of pharmaceutical products.
 
 

• Design, develop and validate sensitive and robust analytical methods for trace-level analysis quantification (with a primary focus on nitrosamine and NDSRI’s) using LC-MS/MS and HRMS, in compliance with ICH, FDA, and EMA guidelines.  

• Perform complex sample preparation and analysis in diverse pharmaceutical matrices, applying expertise in mass spectrometry (Triple Quadrupole, HRMS), chromatographic separation (UHPLC) and sample preparation.  

• Design robust extraction and sample clean-up strategies (e.g., SPE, liquid-liquid extraction) to overcome severe matrix effects in complex drug products, while strictly preventing artifact generation during analysis. 

• Conduct and support root cause investigations related to impurity formation, focusing on chemical pathways, impurity profiling, and risk assessment across drug substance and drug product development.  

• Deliver data and reports according to high scientific and quality standards. Contribute to method transfer and GMP documentation.  

• Promote innovation by exploring novel analytical approaches and emerging technologies to enhance detection limits and method robustness.  

• Support lab operations in full compliance with GMP and data integrity standards.  

• Interact with our clients to discuss scientific aspects.
  

• Represent Anabiotec/anacura in internal and external scientific forums and scientific conferences. 
 

• PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry (or a closely) related scientific field) or Master degree with at least 6 years of relevant industry experience.  

• Minimum of 4–6 years of hands-on experience in pharmaceutical R&D or analytical services.  

• Proven experience in LC-MS trace analysis in drug substances, drug products, or excipients is a strong asset.  

• Extensive practical knowledge of mass spectrometry (QqQ and orbitrap) and chromatography.  

• Experience in method development, validation, and transfer under GMP conditions.  

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements (ICH Q2, Q3, FDA/EMA guidance on nitrosamines) and GMP principles.  

• Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken) is required for high-quality scientific reporting. 

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a dynamic laboratory environment to project timelines.  

• Capable of prioritizing tasks across multiple urgent client projects in a dynamic CRO environment.

• Involved in the (bio)-pharmaceutical drug development process of our clients. 

• Responsible for the development of complex LC-MS/MS methods for small molecules, proteins and/or oligonucleotides.  

• Operate & maintain LC-MS/MS and HRMS instrumentation, incl. routine performance checks, calibration and (basic) troubleshooting. You act as a subject matter expert on Mass Spectrometry. 

• Support the introduction, qualification and transfer of new MS technologies and analytical workflows. 

• Support lab operations in full compliance with GMP and data integrity standards.  

• You deliver data and reports according to high scientific and quality standards and interact with our clients to discuss scientific aspects. 
  
 

• PhD (or Master equivalent by experience) in a scientific field with a strong (technical) focus on mass spectrometry. 

• Extensive hands-on experience with LC-MS operation and troubleshooting on high resolution mass spectrometry platforms (ideally combined triple quad MS platforms) is essential. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work on complex analytical investigations, using a systematic root-cause approach to distinguish LC-, MS-, sample- and method-related issues.  

• Experience with a variety of chromatographic separations (e.g. RP-LC, HILIC) and/or nanoflow liquid chromatography is an additional asset. 

• Capable of working to the highest quality standards required to support development, qualification and validation of LC-MS based methods. 

• Proven ability to work in a dynamic laboratory environment to project timelines.  

• Excellent organization and communication skills in English. Knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

Are you handy and do you enjoy working in a production environment? In this role, you are responsible for assembling plastic domes. 

You work with both standard and custom-made products. Every day starts with your task list on a tablet. You process the products, ensure their quality, and handle the packaging so they are ready for shipment to the warehouse. 

Since you are versatile, you help out at different posts when necessary. Do you see yourself working in a two-shift system and want to commit to this role? Don’t wait and apply quickly to join this team!

• Good communication skills in Dutch, English or French
• Work accurately and in a structured way
• 
Flexibility to work in different departments

• Experience with assembly is a plus

• Willingness to work in a two-shift system

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system. You will help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machinery and equipment park, while having the opportunity to further develop your technical skills.
 

You will work in a 2-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00.
 

Your tasks and responsibilities
 

 
• As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your technical expertise, you will help keep production processes reliable and minimise downtime.
 
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
 
• Troubleshooting and resolving electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
 
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical failures.
 
• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
 
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
 
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.
 
• Working closely with the production department to minimise downtime.
 
• Working in accordance with applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
 
• Contributing to a clean, safe and orderly working environment. 

 
• You have a technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or a similar technical field. Relevant practical experience can also be considered.
 
• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
 
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
 
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You are able to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
 
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
 
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.

Do you have experience as a forklift driver and a valid forklift certificate?

Are you willing to work in shifts and in a fast-paced production environment?

This internationally growing production company specializes in innovative solutions for the construction and interior sector and is known for its strong focus on quality and sustainability. They are currently looking for forklift drivers to join their team in Desselgem in a stable and modern working environment.

What will you do?

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Transporting goods within the warehouse
• Supplying materials to the production lines
• SCanning and checking incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse clean and organized

• Forklift certificate
• Experience as a forklift driver
• Knowledge Dutch or English
• Willing to work in shifts

Do you have experience as an operator? 
Do you also know how to drive a forklift truck? 

Then we are looking for you!

For a company in Kluisbergen we are looking for a logistic operator. 

You will work in two shifts. 

• experience as forklift driver
• experience as operator
• good knowledge of English

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver – Sea Container Transport
jobs.description:
Job description 

You will transport sea containers on dedicated shuttle and short-haul routes between the major port terminals and various warehouses throughout the Port of Antwerp.

As the majority of your work involves local shuttle runs between warehouses and terminals, you can avoid long motorway traffic jams while keeping your schedule tight, efficient, and predictable.

You will work confidently with the various terminal systems and carefully check all container and seal numbers to ensure everything is correct.

Thanks to flexible departure locations, you can also avoid unnecessary commuting time. In consultation with the planning team, you can start from a strategic location in the port that is most convenient for you.

An average working day is approximately 12 hours. However, if you prefer a better work-life balance, a 4/5 employment arrangement or part-time schedule is absolutely negotiable.

You will join a stable, permanent position with a clear focus on reliable, long-term cooperation.

 Requirements 

    
• Qualifications: You hold a valid CE driving licence and an up-to-date Code 95 qualification.
    
• Language skills: You speak and understand Dutch or English well enough to communicate smoothly and effectively.
    
• Administration: You ensure the accurate and correct handling of CMR consignment notes and terminal documentation.
    
• Professional attitude: You are a serious, reliable professional who always works in a customer-friendly and presentable manner.

jobs.occupation: Chauffeur at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Brussels is looking for a Chauffeur to join the Executive Office.

Reacts defensively in response to potential security threat-related situations. Analyses the daily appointment schedule, ensuring familiarity with both a primary and alternate route to the destination, as well as potential security concerns at destination.

EXPERIENCE: 3 years of professional driving.

LANGUAGE: Good working knowledge in English. Good working knowledge in French or Dutch.

DRIVER'S LICENSE C

• You have an A2 degree in Mechanics or equivalent experience.
• You have knowledge of a guillotine shear, press brake, corner notcher, and punching machine.
• You can read and interpret technical drawings.
• Good spatial insight is essential.
• You work accurately and can work independently after the training period.
• Order, cleanliness, and safety are second nature to you.
• English or Dutch.

public authorities.

Are you a financial expert and does accounting have no secrets for you? Do you like studying figures and do you like to have ownership? Then the position of Accounting Specialist at Miele Belux is your next career step! In this position, you are the pivot between the financial processes, the people and the resulting administration. Together with the controllers, shared service centre and external parties, such as our accountants and advisors, you ensure accurate accounting. This not only involves the correct administration of the figures, but also identifying bottlenecks and risks in terms of legislation and regulations. You will be working in a multinational team, with a manager who focuses on your talents and prepares you for a great career within Miele. The many international contacts within the Miele group offer you the opportunity to build an interesting network.
 

What you will be doing:
 

The Accounting Specialist plays a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization by ensuring accurate financial record-keeping, timely processing of transactions, and compliance with group financial policies and local regulatory requirements. The role supports effective financial management through attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to excellence. You are the first point of contact within the Belgium affiliate and the right hand of the Accounting Manager covering the cluster of Belgium/Luxembourg/Netherlands/France.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
 

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities for the Belgian entity in collaboration with our global shared services (MGS) teams in Poland. 

• Ensure accurate bookings, accruals, reconciliations, and allocations to cost and profit centers. 

• Be a key point of contact for external and internal audit matters. 

• Support tax and legal compliance processes, including VAT, and other statutory declarations. 

• Evaluate internal systems, controls, and risks, and provide recommendations for improvement. 

• Contribute to Belgian and global process optimization projects. 

• Support the FP&A team with financial transparency, reporting, and follow-up.  

 

The Accounting Specialist we are looking for:
 

We are looking for someone who is structured, accountable, and principled, with a strong sense of ownership for financial integrity and operational follow-through. You enjoy working with both numbers and practical coordination, and you are comfortable communicating with internal stakeholders as well as external service partners.
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting, economics, business administration. 

• +8 years of experience in a similar role. 

• A strong accounting foundation, with proven experience in closing periods, balance sheet ownership, statutory and tax reporting. 

• Handles sensitive financial information with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability while adhering to professional and organizational standards. 

• Communicates financial information clearly and professionally to colleagues, management, auditors, and other stakeholders. 

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach with a passion for continuous improvement and eagerness to take ownership, contribute to harmonization of processes across the region. 

• Works collaboratively across departments and builds positive relationships. 

• Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• Experience in a multinational, multi-location matrix environment.. 

• Experience working with SAP is an advantage, proficiency in Excel. 

• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch/French, both written and verbal.
